narrative.overview: Conduit is printed, not rendered: a warm-paper Medium clone pulled through a two-ink risograph press. One fluoro-orange ink does all the shouting; one indigo-black ink does all the structure. The signature is misregistration — orange display type carrying a faint indigo ghost — and every hover is the second ink rolling over the first.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks, one paper; a third color is a bug
Sharp-cut cards, soft dies only on small controls

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every color is fluoro or ink mixed with paper; a third hue never enters the page.

rules.name: The Reaction Rule
rules.body: Orange is a reaction, ink is structure: resting text is ink; the loud ink appears on hover, active, brand, and stamp.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: Anton sets the brand and page names in lowercase; uppercase is reserved for small UI labels.

dos: Mix every tint from the two inks and paper
Keep article measure at or under 74ch
Theme browser surfaces: selection, scrollbar, focus rings
donts: No third color, including the old RealWorld green
No soft shadows on resting elements
Never rename the spec's classes, names, placeholders, or text labels
